title: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis
lede: daily_stock_analysis is a Python tool that runs a stock watchlist through an LLM each trading day, combining quotes and news into a decision report pushed to chat apps or email.

points: Covers A-shares and stocks in Hong Kong, the U.S., Japan, Korea and Taiwan, plus ETFs.
Each report gives a score, trend, buy and sell levels, risk alerts and catalysts per stock.
Runs free on a forked repo's GitHub Actions on weekdays, or locally, in Docker or as a FastAPI service.
Works with Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, Ollama and other OpenAI-compatible models; bundled free data sources need no setup.
A web workbench adds backtesting, holdings and a chat page that answers using 15 built-in strategies.

points.text: Feeding after-the-fact reviews of past decision signals back into the agent's memory.
A roadmap to use local coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode as the analysis backend.
Raising prompt-cache hit rates to cut the cost of each LLM analysis.
A post-close sentiment review for the A-share market.
